title: bump_version
description: Bumps the project or component version string in version files such as package.json, pyproject.toml, or VERSION.

version.description: The new version string to set (e.g. '1.4.0', '2.0.0-rc.1'). Must be a valid semantic version.

pre_release.description: An optional pre-release identifier appended to the version (e.g. 'alpha', 'beta.1', 'rc.2').
